discussion.question: Should the university require first-year students to live on campus? Why or why not?

s1.name: Helena
s1.text: I support a requirement for the first year because new students find friends and help faster when they live close to class. A clear exception should exist for people who already care for relatives.

s2.name: Diego
s2.text: I disagree. Housing is expensive, and some students already live nearby with family. A requirement would charge them for a solution they do not need and might push them to work more hours.
